# Learner Progress

## Summary
One enrolment's live standing: Donut Chart of released work, attendance %, letter, and the completion verdict clause by clause via `evaluateCompletion()` — the same function Issue Certificate runs.

## Usage
`<LearnerProgress @enrollment @context @compact />`

## Non-goals
Stores nothing.
